notes: Centered lane position for quiz3_app's lane centering with the DASHES detector (track_vision.detect_line) on the middle of the full camera view. From the Nov 16 lobby calibration pass (dash fit near 0.782 / far 0.708), shifted 2.5 in: with these values the robot drove straight but 2-3 in LEFT of the line, i.e. the pass was driven ~2.5 in left. Far row: road 155 px = 12.6 in (12.3 px/in); a sideways offset moves the near row 1/0.6 as much (offset_far_ratio). Result matches the lab's centered values (0.718 / 0.662, lane_center_lab.json). The road-surface detector misread the line in the lobby (found 32/97 frames).
